def process(loadPhosphoGenes) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    # show original columns and first few values to understand if FDR exists but was mis-read as header

    preview_vals = loadPhosphoGenes.iloc[:15, 0].astype(str).tolist()
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'nrows': [len(loadPhosphoGenes)],
        'ncols': [loadPhosphoGenes.shape[1]],
        'only_column_name': [col],
        'first15_values': [" | ".join(preview_vals)]
    })

def process(loadSsPhospho) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadSsPhospho.copy()

    # Coerce to numeric in case of mixed dtypes
    df['FDR.phos'] = pd.to_numeric(df['FDR.phos'], errors='coerce')

    cbx3_mean = df.loc[df['Gene'].astype(str).str.strip().eq('CBX3'), 'FDR.phos'].mean()
    rest_mean = df.loc[~df['Gene'].astype(str).str.strip().eq('CBX3'), 'FDR.phos'].mean()

    diff = cbx3_mean - rest_mean

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'cbx3_mean_fdr': cbx3_mean,
        'rest_mean_fdr': rest_mean,
        'difference': diff
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute mean FDR.phos for rows where Gene == 'CBX3' vs all other genes (using sheet F-SS-phospho from loadSsPhospho); coerce FDR.phos to numeric; return cbx3_mean_fdr, rest_mean_fdr, and their difference (CBX3 minus rest) in a single-row DataFrame
